name: Trait JustTiling
description:
Automatic window tiling for a single-monitor GNOME desktop. Independent workspace layouts, adjustable splits, drag-and-drop swaps with visual previews and keyboard swaps, focus highlighting, application-wide floating exceptions and local learning of manually preferred app positions and sizes.

Interface available in English and Portuguese. Default shortcuts: Super+T to toggle tiling, Super+O to toggle the active window, Super+F to cycle focus through tiled windows, Super+C to choose a numbered window for swapping, and Super+Arrow to swap windows. The arrow shortcuts temporarily replace conflicting system bindings and restore them when tiling stops. Shortcuts are configurable.

On Debian/Ubuntu, unidentified helper windows can inherit application exceptions through read-only installed-package queries. Multiple-monitor tiling is not supported.
